_comment: Tiles on the launch page (index.html). Each tile launches a scenario file from web/scenarios/. Variants are alternative files for the same feature, e.g. study conditions.

tiles.title: Predictive fleet management
tiles.description: A delivery mission with live estimates of when it will finish. Before you add or remove a drone, the panel shows how the finish time and mission cost would change.

tiles.title: Operator lenses
tiles.description: Turn map lenses on and off: position uncertainty, communication range, path prediction, and the explored and hazard overlays.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Scan review and triage
tiles.description: Drones scan the area and the images arrive for review. Triage each find as high, medium or low priority, and ground vehicles respond in that order.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Progressive-resolution scouting
tiles.description: Five drones fly to twelve reported casualties. Click a target to open its image on the map: it sharpens live as a drone closes in. Decide as soon as you are sure and that drone moves on; leave it and the drone decides on arrival, right 80% of the time. 90 seconds, scored on correct finds per minute times accuracy.

tiles.title: Resolution study
tiles.description: Send your five drones to search areas of Southampton Common. Each find sends a compressed image to the scans window. Classify it, or when you are unsure request a better scan and a drone goes back for a high-resolution image. Eight minutes to find as many casualties as you can.

tiles.title: Strategic and tactical assistants
tiles.showcasing: Trust in a two-tier team of assistants
tiles.description: Search-and-rescue calls arrive one after another. Decide how many Fast, Lifter and Camera drones each mission gets, with a Strategic Assistant offering two strategies, then plan which drone does which task in a second window, where a Tactical Assistant can fill in the plan. Drones fail along the way. Includes the guided tutorial, the surveys and the full study flow.
tiles.note: Opens the strategic view. Open the tactical view in a second window from its start screen.

tiles.title: Drone programmer
tiles.description: Agents run their own programmed policies. With limited communication, the operator sees their last known positions and the targets relayed back to the hub.

papers.venue: Putting AI in the Critical Loop (book chapter)

tiles.title: Adaptive abstraction
tiles.description: A high-workload mission where agents and tasks are drawn as heatmaps instead of individual markers. Each team has its own colour, and each mission shows which of its tasks are covered. Drag a team onto a mission to send it there.
